name: PMETAL
recent: 近期公告主要是 EPF 及主要股东、董事的持股变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，分析员关注铝供应紧张缓解、铝价走软及碳阳极成本上升对下半年冶炼利润率的影响，同时有报道预期第三季核心盈利表现。
risks: EPF 在约三周内连续多次申报持股变动。
多名主要股东及董事在 10 月 19 日至 21 日申报持股变动。
新闻提及铝价下跌及碳阳极成本上升带来盈利压力。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 4,687.95 million，环比增长 14.4%，同比增长 11.9%；净利为 MYR 800.996 million，环比增长 28.3%，同比增长 65.6%；净利率为 17.1%，高于上一季度的 15.2%。

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly shareholding change filings by EPF and key shareholders/directors, with no major corporate activities. In the news, analysts focused on the impact of easing aluminium supply tightness, softer aluminium prices and rising carbon anode costs on 2H smelting margins, while one report projected Q3 core earnings.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple shareholding change notices over about three weeks.
Several key shareholders and directors filed shareholding change notices between 19 and 21 October.
News reports cited earnings pressure from falling aluminium prices and rising carbon anode costs.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 4,687.95 million, up 14.4% QoQ and 11.9% YoY; net income was MYR 800.996 million, up 28.3% QoQ and 65.6% YoY; net margin was 17.1%, higher than 15.2% in the previous quarter.
